stories.title: Bears QB Williams leaves on cart after falling on scramble
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings with a right hamstring injury.

stories.title: Ole Miss up to No. 4, LSU slides to 10th as 10 SEC teams ranked
stories.summary: Ole Miss moved into the top five with its win over LSU, the Tigers stayed in the top 10, and Florida and Mississippi State cracked the rankings to give the SEC 10 teams in The Associated Press Top 25.

stories.title: Cubs 3B Bregman hit in face by foul ball while on deck
stories.summary: Cubs third baseman Alex Bregman left Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Reds after being struck in the face by a foul ball while standing in the on-deck circle.

stories.title: Lynx's Miles breaks Clark's WNBA rookie points record
stories.summary: Olivia Miles broke Caitlin Clark's WNBA record for points by a rookie in a season during the Lynx's game against the Sun.

stories.title: Longtime exec Accorsi, architect of Giants' historic SB team, dies at 84
stories.summary: Longtime NFL executive Ernie Accorsi, the architect of the Giants team that pulled off one of the biggest upsets in Super Bowl history, has died. He was 84.
